entry.name: bag
entry.description: Stores and manages a collection of numbers. You can add to or delete an integer from a bag as well as report its contents. bag with any argument maintains multiple entries with the same item; otherwise it holds only one of each.

arguments.name: duplicate-flag
arguments.description: The presence of any symbol argument causes theto store duplicate values. If there is no argument,will store only one of each number at a time.

messages.name: bang
messages.description: In left inlet: Causesto send all its collected numbers out the outlet.

messages.name: clear
messages.description: In left inlet: Deletes the entire contents of the.

messages.name: cut
messages.description: In left inlet: Sends out the oldest (earliest received) number stored in theobject, and deletes it from the.

messages.name: in1
messages.digest: Set the operation for the next received input
messages.description: In right inlet: The number is stored as an indicator of whether to include or delete the next number received in the left inlet. If non-zero, the number received in the left inlet is added to the. If 0, the number is deleted from the.No output is triggered by a number received in either inlet.

messages.name: int
messages.description: In left inlet: The number is either added to or deleted from the collection of numbers stored in theobject, depending on the number in the right inlet.In right inlet: The number is stored as an indicator of whether to include or delete the next number received in the left inlet. If non-zero, the number received in the left inlet is added to the. If 0, the number is deleted from the collection.No output is triggered by a number received in either inlet.

messages.name: length
messages.description: In left inlet: Reports how many numbers are currently stored in the.

messages.name: list
messages.description: Any list composed of two numbers behaves as though the first list item was sent to the left inlet and the second list item was sent to the right inlet. If the second element of the list is a non-zero number, the number is added to the collection.

messages.name: send
messages.digest: Send all entries to a receive object
messages.description: In left inlet: The word, followed by the name of aobject, sends the result of amessage to allobjects with that name, instead of out theobject's outlet.
